phrase.zh: 从颜色里，辨认看不见的组成。
phrase.en: Within color, discover the unseen components.

visual.zh: 放大的胡萝卜横切面从左侧越出画面，一条带状形态从切面延伸并向右分成两股；细刻线保留切面的放射纹理。
visual.en: An enlarged carrot cross-section crops at the left. A ribbon-like form extends from its face and divides into two strands toward the right; fine lines preserve the radial texture of the cut surface.

background.zh:
卡雷尔因研究类胡萝卜素、黄素以及维生素A和B2，获得1937年诺贝尔化学奖的一半，另一半授予霍沃思。他研究植物色素的化学结构及其与维生素的关系。画面让胡萝卜横切面延伸出一条分为两股的色素带，表达辨认成分；这不是准确的分子结构、真实分离方法或测量图，也不表达营养治疗效果。短句为原创。
1937年化学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：研究类胡萝卜素、黄素以及维生素A和B2
background.en:
Karrer received half the 1937 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for investigating carotenoids, flavins and vitamins A and B2; Haworth received the other half. He studied plant pigment structures and their relation to vitamins. A pigment ribbon separating into two strands from a carrot cross-section symbolizes identifying components. It is not a molecular structure, actual separation procedure or measured graph, and makes no nutritional treatment claim. The phrase is original.
1937 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for his investigations on carotenoids, flavins and vitamins A and B2
